input: scheduled: continue work on the repo (revenue products)

doc_friction.issue: `redteam.py targets` (no --probe) printed a short sample, not the 5263 guarded files, so grepping it for a recently changed file found nothing; went straight to --target after timing the suite by hand.

notes: Step 0: all 10 open entries are control-plane workflow edits that already have open PRs awaiting owner approval (#14894, #14808, #15248, #15201, #14698, #12926, #14612, #14877, #15561, #12928); nothing to add from an ordinary branch. Campaigns: wash-sale-checker/calc.mjs 7/10 caught (1 gap: three-digit month; 2 equivalent float tolerances), shift-roster-builder/calc.mjs 5/8 caught (1 gap: BIG_WEEK boundary, guarded via exported defaultBudgetMs; 2 equivalent); the shift-roster suite took ~25 min for 8 mutants, so run it in the background. Hunt: three header-order defects in wash-sale-checker column detection (settlement date as trade date gave a false wash; Security Type read as symbol and 'Stock' as the sto sell code; Account Type read as action), fixed with preference-ordered names plus exclusion patterns and whole-word option codes; added Robinhood headers and real Fidelity/Schwab export tests. Guard (4b): the class has no siblings (grep for the first-substring findIndex pattern and the sto/stc regex found none beyond one unrelated calculator), so the tests are the guard; no new lint.

real_defects.issue: Settlement Date before Trade Date: the 30-day window ran from settlement, so a 31-day repurchase (by trade date) was reported as a $200 wash.
Security Type before Symbol: every symbol became STOCK and 'Stock' matched the sto sell code, so every row was a sale (silent wrong answer, wash missed).
Account Type before Action: every row refused as 'action must be buy or sell'.
